description: Use when you want to know how one stock's returns co-move with macro factors such as rates, credit, oil, the dollar or volatility. Not for the macro factor return series themselves (use riskmodels_get_factor_returns). Returns, from POST /correlation, Pearson or Spearman correlations over a trailing window, using the L3 residual return by default. End-of-day data, refreshed after each US market close. Price: $0.01 per call.

factors.description: Macro factor keys, e.g. ["oil","usd","term_spread"] (default: the standard set)

ticker.description: US stock ticker symbol, case-insensitive, e.g. NVDA

window_days.description: Trailing window in trading days, integer, e.g. 126 (default 252)

name: riskmodels_get_macro_correlation
title: RiskModels Macro Factor Correlation
